Rounds 1.7.0

This release makes Rounds safer and sharper when reasoning about your health.

  • Exact medication dose checks. When you ask “can I take another dose?” for common over-the-counter pain and fever medicines (acetaminophen/paracetamol, ibuprofen, naproxen, aspirin), Rounds now computes the rolling 24-hour total and the time until your next safe dose exactly, instead of estimating — and flags hidden duplicate ingredients in combination products.
  • More careful clinical reasoning. The assistant now screens for dangerous “can’t-miss” conditions before settling on the likely cause, and guards against jumping to conclusions too early.
  • Better memory of your history. Facts are kept with who said them and when, and current values are clearly separated from past ones — so an old result is never mistaken for today’s, and your own guesses aren’t treated as established fact.
  • A wider safety net. The instant red-flag detector now also recognizes possible overdose/poisoning and severe alcohol or sedative withdrawal.
  • Fewer needless refusals of legitimate questions about your own records, plus groundwork to keep improving this.

Everything continues to run locally on your Mac. Your documents never leave except as de-identified, concept-only lookups.
